# opaque frame in

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:opaqueFrameIn`](gmeow-opaqueFrameIn.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/opaqueFrameIn>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/gts`](../../slices/gts.md)

The GTS segment an opaque frame belongs to. Functional: a frame occupies one position in one segment's chain.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:OpaqueFrame`](../classes/gmeow-OpaqueFrame.md) -> [`gmeow:GTSSegment`](../classes/gmeow-GTSSegment.md); functional
**Sub-property of:** [`gmeow:partOf`](gmeow-partOf.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:opaqueFrameIn`](gmeow-opaqueFrameIn.md) from [`gmeow:OpaqueFrame`](../classes/gmeow-OpaqueFrame.md) to [`gmeow:GTSSegment`](../classes/gmeow-GTSSegment.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.
